name: Data.lifts_auxLift
summary: The adjoint lift is the algebraic form of a theta lift; transfer the sphericity of y through it.

steps.claim: Let w be split with w, w̄ off the places of the pair. By adjointness (`Data.inner_auxLift`) and `AuxPair.adjoint_theta_eq_formLift`, auxLift(D, ϑ, j)(y) is the algebraic form of the theta lift of y through the arrow of the pair (`IsEdge.isArrow`); y is spherical at w with Hecke polynomial heckePolyEval(p(w, ·)) (`Data.isSphericalWith_of_mem_eigenPart`, w being split and off the chosen places above g); the Hecke transfer for theta lifts (`isSphericalWith_formLift`) gives the Hecke polynomial required by Lifts, the characters being unramified at w (`AutChar.HasWeight.charUnramifiedAt`, `AuxPair.tame_eq_one`) and the datum unramified at w (`Space.projOn_name_vacElem`); sphericity passes to the algebraic form (`isSphericalWith_toAlgForm_iff`).
steps.lean:
(p ⟨·, ·⟩) := fun w hw hS ↦ adjoint_theta_eq_formLift _ (D.fitsParams_auxPair ϑ j)
  (D.inner_auxLift ϑ y) ▸ (isSphericalWith_toAlgForm_iff ..).2 (isSphericalWith_formLift (by
    simp [AuxPair.rankDiff]) (HasWeight.charUnramifiedAt rfl rfl) (by grind
  [HasWeight.charUnramifiedAt, tame_eq_one]) hw (by simp_all [auxDatum, projOn_name_vacElem,
  places_levelModulus]) ((D.fitsParams_auxPair ϑ j).isEdge.isArrow _ _ (auxDatum _).2).1
  (D.isSphericalWith_of_mem_eigenPart _ hy ⟨hw, by simp_all [auxPair, levelPlaces]⟩))
